liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (3 reviews): Reviewer enjoyed the Black Peter performance; Best Black Peter and Cumberland Blues of 1969 so far [3][6][10]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): Pig Pen's rave in Lovelight had extra sauce [7]

## The recordings

- **gd69-12-13.sbd.clugston.5583.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 92 min; rated 3.7/5 by 22 [1]. Said about its sound: Sound quality was surprisingly nice [3]

## Around the show

- San Bernardino venue was described as lackluster [5]
- Someone fed a dog in the reviewer's bus while stealing tape [11]
- Good banter occurred during the show [12]
- Playing was sloppier than the previous night [2]
- Rocked as hard as any show from that era [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd69-12-13.sbd.clugston.5583.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: 7-inch masters transferred to cassette, DAT, CDR, then SHN [1]
